description: The pie chart presents the distribution of question-answering datasets (or categories) by share of the total, showing 5 slices in total: TriviaQA (colored red) at about 46% (1829), WebQA (colored purple) at about 25% (997), HalluEval (colored green) at about 18% (721), HalluQA (colored light blue) at about 5% (185), and an unlabeled yellow slice at about 6% (231). Percentage values and counts are printed next to the slices, and several slices appear visually emphasized by being slightly separated/offset from the center (notably the large red TriviaQA segment and the small yellow segment). No separate legend is shown, and the slices appear arranged roughly from the largest segment on the left to smaller segments around the right and bottom.
